axes.name: Best-chain selection
axes.criterion: How the node picks the active tip.

axes.name: Block-size consensus rule
axes.criterion: The dedicated maximum-block-size consensus rule (ignoring the generic serialisation ceiling).

axes.name: Script opcode vocabulary
axes.criterion: Status of the broad opcode set v0.1 shipped and 2010 disabled (OP_CAT, OP_MUL, bitwise, etc.).

axes.name: Script-number operand width
axes.criterion: The maximum width of a numeric script operand.

axes.name: Script element-size limit
axes.criterion: The maximum size of a single stack element.

axes.name: Signature encoding
axes.criterion: Whether strict-DER signature encoding is enforced.

axes.name: Output-value range check
axes.criterion: Whether outputs/sums are bounded by a MoneyRange invariant (vs only nValue < 0).

axes.name: Signature scheme
axes.criterion: Whether a Schnorr scheme is available in consensus in addition to ECDSA.

axes.name: Pay-to-Script-Hash (P2SH)
axes.criterion: Whether the P2SH special-case output template is a consensus rule.

axes.name: Segregated witness
axes.criterion: Whether witness data is segregated with a separate commitment (BIP141).

axes.name: Taproot output type
axes.criterion: Whether Taproot (BIP341 key/script-path) outputs are a consensus rule.

axes.name: Timelock opcodes
axes.criterion: Whether CLTV/CSV-style timelock opcodes are active (v0.1 leaves the slots as NOPs).

axes.name: Difficulty-adjustment algorithm
axes.criterion: The retarget algorithm governing proof-of-work difficulty, INCLUDING any additional real-time target a block must also satisfy to be accepted.

axes.name: Replay protection
axes.criterion: Whether a fork-id is mixed into the signature hash.

axes.name: Transaction ordering in a block
axes.criterion: Whether non-coinbase transactions must follow a canonical order (CTOR) vs topological.

axes.name: Initial block subsidy
axes.criterion: The genesis-era block subsidy (coins per block before the first halving).

axes.name: Target block spacing
axes.criterion: The target mean time between blocks.

axes.name: Coinbase height commitment
axes.criterion: Whether the block height must appear in the coinbase input (BIP34).

axes.name: Proof-of-work function
axes.criterion: The hash function a valid block header must satisfy the target under.

sources.nov08: 15 Nov 2008 pre-release source (SNI code archive; source-bounded model)
sources.c_chainwork: bitcoin/bitcoin 3b7cd5d8 (2010, v0.3.3): best chain by cumulative work
sources.c_opdis: bitcoin/bitcoin 4bd188c4 (15 Aug 2010): disable OP_CAT/OP_MUL/bitwise etc. + 520 B element limit + nMaxNumSize 258->4
sources.cve2010: CVE-2010-5139 value-overflow fix: MoneyRange / output-sum check (Aug 2010)
sources.bch_fork: Bitcoin Cash Aug 2017 fork: SIGHASH_FORKID replay protection, 8 MB blocks
sources.bch_2018: BCH May 2018 upgrade: re-enable OP_CAT/OP_SPLIT/bitwise/OP_DIV etc., 32 MB
sources.bch_abla: CHIP-2023-04 Adaptive Blocksize Limit Algorithm (gitlab.com/0353F40E/ebaa, status Accepted). Activated on BCH mainnet at MTP >= 1715774400 (15 May 2024 12:00:00 UTC) per upgradespecs.bitcoincashnode.org/2024-05-15-upgrade. The maximum block size becomes ALGORITHMICALLY VARYING, not a constant
sources.bch_vm_limits: CHIP-2021-05 Targeted Virtual Machine Limits (github.com/bitjson/bch-vm-limits, status Final, v3.1.3). Activated 2025-05-15T12:00:00Z. Raises the stack element length limit from 520 to 10,000 bytes
sources.abc_src: Bitcoin ABC source, src/script/script.h (master): 'static const unsigned int MAX_SCRIPT_ELEMENT_SIZE = 520;' and 'constexpr size_t MAX_SCRIPTNUM_BYTE_SIZE = 8;'. For a chain the implementation IS the consensus rule
sources.bch_ctor: BCH Nov 2018 upgrade: CTOR (canonical tx ordering), OP_CHECKDATASIG
sources.bch_daa_2017: BCH 13 Nov 2017 upgrade: cw-144 difficulty algorithm, replacing the EDA that the 1 Aug 2017 fork shipped
sources.bch_asert: BCH Nov 2020 upgrade: ASERT (aserti3-2d) difficulty algorithm
sources.bch_bigint: CHIP-2024-07 BigInt: High-Precision Arithmetic for Bitcoin Cash (github.com/bitjson/bch-bigint), activated 15 May 2025. NOT the May 2022 upgrade, which delivered 64-bit script integers
sources.bsv_no_schnorr: ABSENCE: no BSV upgrade specification introduces Schnorr signatures; genesis-spec.md does not mention ECDSA or Schnorr at all (measured 14 Aug 2026). Weaker footing than a positive citation, by construction
sources.bsv_genesis: bitcoin-sv-specs/protocol genesis-spec.md (Feb 2020): remove block cap, remove P2SH, restore opcodes / miner-configurable limits; sunsets CLTV and CSV to NOPs; Numeric Value Size Consensus Rule = 750,000 bytes
sources.bsv_chronicle: bitcoin-sv-specs/protocol chronicle-spec.md: script-number consensus limit 750KB -> 32MB; further opcode additions. Activation height: the spec states mainnet 943,835, the BSV Node v1.2.0 release notes state 943,816 (7 Apr 2026); both precede the freeze, so the cell value is unaffected
sources.btg_src: BTCGPU/BTCGPU src/chainparams.cpp (master): BIP34Height = 227931, SegwitHeight = 481824, nPowTargetSpacing = 10*60, LWMA difficulty, Equihash PoW. BTG forked at height 491,406, AFTER BIP34 and segwit activated on Bitcoin, so it inherits both. For a chain the implementation IS the consensus rule
sources.btg_fork: Bitcoin Gold Oct 2017 fork: SIGHASH_FORKID-style replay protection, Equihash-BTG (Zhash 144,5) proof-of-work, ledger duplicated to block 491,406
sources.bip34: BIP34: coinbase must contain the block height. Activated on Bitcoin mainnet 2013 (Core consensus param BIP34Height = 227931), therefore inherited by every chain in this set, all of which forked later
sources.xec_asert: eCash (XEC) inherits ASERT from Bitcoin Cash ABC (Nov 2020) and has additionally enforced Real Time Targeting (Heartbeat) since Nov 2024: a second difficulty on top of the base DAA, with blocks exceeding the Real Time Target rejected
sources.shared: inherited unchanged from v0.1 by all descendants (21e6 cap, 210k-block halving, ~10-min target); XEC redenominated units (2 decimals) without changing the schedule

reasons.script_opcodes: inherited the 2010 opcode restrictions through the BTC->BCH lineage; the 2020 Genesis upgrade re-enabled the broad set (c_opdis -> bsv_genesis)
reasons.element_size_limit: inherited the 520-byte element cap from 2010; Genesis removed the consensus limit (c_opdis -> bsv_genesis)
reasons.p2sh: P2SH was a consensus rule on BSV's lineage from 2012; Genesis removed it (bip16 -> bsv_genesis)
reasons.timelock_opcodes: CLTV and CSV were consensus rules on BSV's lineage from 2015-16 (BIP65, BIP112, both predating the 2017 fork); genesis-spec.md sunsets them, saying the operations revert to NOPs which have no effect (bip65+bip112 -> bsv_genesis)

cases.name: block-size labels unified
cases.rationale: v0.1.0's 'no-dedicated-cap' and BSV's 'no-consensus-cap' name the same state

cases.name: script-number qualifier dropped (inert since the BSV cell became 32mb-limit)
cases.rationale: v0.1.0's 'unbounded-openssl' drops its implementation qualifier; no profile carries 'unbounded' any more, so this moves nothing -- retained because it was live when the analysis was designed

cases.name: BSV opcode set individuated
cases.rationale: BSV's post-Genesis opcode set is NOT v0.1's: it adds CHECKDATASIG, OP_SPLIT, NUM2BIN/BIN2NUM and still disables OP_2MUL/2DIV/VERIF/VERNOTIF

note: reference-relative mismatch counts/rates; NOT a metric and NOT a ranking of which chain 'is' Bitcoin; every cell is source-anchored (see METHOD.md).
